title: Something a person should read
description: Consumed by notifications, which delivers it to Telegram or Discord. Published by trading and - until it retires - by structures, so this is one of the two topics with more than one producer. Filtered at the consumer rather than the publisher, deliberately: what is worth recording and what is worth interrupting someone with are different questions, and the journal keeps everything either way.

title.description: The only required field. `notifications.service.from_message` returns None for an empty or missing one and the loop drops the message with a warning, so a producer that forgets it is silently not alerting.

level.description: Drives colour and prefix, nothing else. Parsed leniently - absent is INFO - so a name or its ordinal both work.

source.description: Which service sent it. Left empty by most producers and filled in by the consumer from the bus message's own source, so an empty string here is normal rather than a gap.

fields.description: The structured bits a destination may render. Every value is coerced to a string by the consumer, because a notifier renders text and not arbitrary JSON - so nesting here is silently flattened to its repr. `shape` is what NOTIFY_SHAPES routes on and must match the producer's own word exactly; a mismatch drops every alert of that shape while the path itself works.

image.description: An optional picture. Untrusted like the rest: the bytes must decode, be a PNG or JPEG by their own header, and fit MAX_IMAGE_BYTES (5,000,000). A destination that fails to send it retries once without it, because an alert must never be lost for its picture.
